description: Average monthly housing costs per household in Switzerland (BFS household budget survey HABE): net rent or mortgage interest, ancillary costs (Nebenkosten: flat-rate charges, water, waste water, waste, upkeep), energy (electricity, gas/fuels, heating), with BFS quality grades. Latest year for Switzerland; with canton also the values of its major region (pooled period). Means over all households incl. owners.

canton.description: Canton as 2-letter abbreviation, e.g. "ZH", "GE", "TI". Mapped to its BFS major region; omit for Switzerland.

title: Household housing costs
